body: ## Summary - persist the source URL and importer format on URL-imported collections - add a Refresh action for URL-imported root collections - refetch the source and run the existing OpenAPI importer again - replace the collection contents in place while preserving the collection ID and `_ref_id` - keep the previous collection unchanged when fetching or importing fails - persist URL source metadata through personal and team collection data ## Notes The current URL collection import flow exposes OpenAPI as the URL-based collection importer, so the refresh action is scoped to URL-imported OpenAPI collections. Closes #6657 --- ## Summary by cubic Adds a refresh action for URL-imported OpenAPI collections so they can be re-fetched and re-imported in place, preserving the collection ID and `_ref_id`. Failed fetches or imports leave the existing collection unchanged. - Persists the source URL and importer format on URL-imported collections across personal and team data; non-URL imports remain untouched. - Adds a Refresh action to URL-imported root collections that reruns the OpenAPI importer and replaces the collection contents. - Bumps the collection schema to version 13 and migrates existing collections automatically. Written for commit 735a6a0806f90e013339ea76d08d0b6cb2d9c62c. Summary will update on new commits.
title: feat: refresh collections imported from URL
